meaning.en: Different people see the same thing differently.
meaning.zh: 对同一问题，不同的人有不同的看法。

equivalents: in the eye of the beholder

examples.zh: 这部电影好不好看，见仁见智。
examples.en: Whether the film's any good is a matter of opinion.

examples.zh: 关于教育方式，大家见仁见智。
examples.en: When it comes to parenting styles, everyone has their own view.

examples.zh: 这是个见仁见智的问题，没有标准答案。
examples.en: It's a question of personal taste; there's no right answer.

story.en: The Book of Changes: 'The humane see it and call it humaneness; the wise see it and call it wisdom' (仁者见之谓之仁，知者见之谓之知).
story.zh: 《周易·系辞上》：“仁者见之谓之仁，知者见之谓之知。”

meaning.en: Never moving even an inch away; always staying close.
meaning.zh: 一步也不离开，形容关系密切或看护严密。

examples.zh: 孩子生病那几天，妈妈寸步不离地守在床边。
examples.en: While the child was ill, Mum never left the bedside.

examples.zh: 保镖对明星寸步不离。
examples.en: The bodyguard never leaves the star's side.

examples.zh: 这只小狗整天跟着主人，寸步不离。
examples.en: The puppy follows its owner everywhere.

meaning.en: Charming, gentle scenery.
meaning.zh: 风景柔美动人。

examples.zh: 这座海岛风光旖旎，游客络绎不绝。
examples.en: The island's scenery is enchanting and the tourists keep coming.

examples.zh: 江南水乡风光旖旎。
examples.en: The water towns of Jiangnan are picturesque.

examples.zh: 湖边风光旖旎，是拍婚纱照的好地方。
examples.en: The idyllic lakeside is perfect for wedding photos.

meaning.en: Praised by everyone, as if every mouth were a monument.
meaning.zh: 所有人的嘴都是活的记功碑，比喻人人称赞。

examples.zh: 这家店的服务有口皆碑。
examples.en: This shop's service is praised by everyone.

examples.zh: 他为村民做的好事有口皆碑。
examples.en: Everyone in the village speaks highly of all he's done for them.

examples.zh: 这款车的质量有口皆碑。
examples.en: The car's reliability is widely acclaimed.

meaning.en: Everyone gets what they need or finds their proper place.
meaning.zh: 每个人或事物都得到适当的安排。

examples.zh: 这样分配，大家各得其所。
examples.en: Shared out like this, everyone gets what they need.

examples.zh: 新制度让人才各得其所。
examples.en: The new system puts every talent in the right job.

examples.zh: 双方各得其所，合作非常愉快。
examples.en: Both sides got what they wanted and the partnership went well.

story.en: Describing the first markets: 'At midday they held a market … they traded and went home, each having got what he needed' (交易而退，各得其所).
story.zh: 《周易·系辞下》：“日中为市，致天下之民，聚天下之货，交易而退，各得其所。”

meaning.en: Neither painful nor itchy; superficial, missing the point.
meaning.zh: 比喻批评、处理等不中要害，没有作用。

examples.zh: 他做了一个不痛不痒的检讨。
examples.en: He made a half-hearted apology.

examples.zh: 这种不痛不痒的处罚根本不起作用。
examples.en: A toothless penalty like that won't work at all.

examples.zh: 评论写得不痛不痒，没说到点子上。
examples.en: The review was bland and missed the point entirely.

meaning.en: Many people (often distinguished) gathered in one hall.
meaning.zh: 形容很多有才能的人聚集在一起。

examples.zh: 各国专家济济一堂，共商环保大计。
examples.en: Experts from many countries gathered to discuss environmental policy.

examples.zh: 老同学们济济一堂，热闹非凡。
examples.en: Old classmates came together under one roof, and it was a lively affair.

examples.zh: 今天大家济济一堂，庆祝公司成立二十周年。
examples.en: We're gathered here today to celebrate the company's twentieth anniversary.

pinyin: bì qí gōng yú yī yì
literal: finish · its · task · in · one · battle

meaning.en: To accomplish the whole task in a single campaign.
meaning.zh: 把应该分几步做的事一次完成。

examples.zh: 改革是长期任务，不可能毕其功于一役。
examples.en: Reform is a long-term task; it can't be done in one fell swoop.

examples.zh: 减肥不能想着毕其功于一役。
examples.en: You can't expect to lose all the weight in one go.

examples.zh: 他希望通过这次谈判毕其功于一役。
examples.en: He hopes to settle everything with this one round of talks.

story.en: Sun Yat-sen (1905) hoped China could achieve its political and social revolutions together, 'accomplishing the task in one campaign' (毕其功于一役).
story.zh: 孙中山《〈民报〉发刊词》：“举政治革命、社会革命毕其功于一役。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于否定句。

meaning.en: To return to one's original, natural simplicity.
meaning.zh: 去掉外在的装饰，恢复原来的质朴状态。

examples.zh: 他辞去高薪工作回到农村，过上了返璞归真的生活。
examples.en: He quit his well-paid job for a simple life back to basics in the countryside.

examples.zh: 这位画家晚年的作品返璞归真。
examples.en: The painter's late works return to a pure simplicity.

examples.zh: 越来越多城里人追求返璞归真。
examples.en: More and more city dwellers are seeking a simpler life.

meaning.en: Calm and unhurried.
meaning.zh: 不慌张，不忙乱，形容从容镇定。

examples.zh: 面对记者的提问，他不慌不忙地回答。
examples.en: He answered the reporters' questions calmly and unhurriedly.

examples.zh: 火警响了，老师不慌不忙地带学生撤离。
examples.en: When the alarm went off, the teacher calmly led the pupils out.

examples.zh: 离开车还有一小时，我们不慌不忙。
examples.en: The train isn't for another hour; we can take our time.

meaning.en: Overflowing with talent.
meaning.zh: 才华充分显露出来。

examples.zh: 她是一位才华横溢的年轻作家。
examples.en: She's an immensely gifted young writer.

examples.zh: 这个导演才华横溢，每部片子都有新意。
examples.en: The director is brimming with talent; every film feels fresh.

examples.zh: 他才华横溢，可惜英年早逝。
examples.en: He was brilliant, but sadly died young.

meaning.en: Something already done that cannot be undone.
meaning.zh: 已经成为现实的事情。

examples.zh: 这件事已成既成事实，再争论也没用。
examples.en: It's a done deal now; there's no point arguing.

examples.zh: 他们想造成既成事实，逼我们接受。
examples.en: They want to present us with a fait accompli.

examples.zh: 婚事已是既成事实，父母只好同意。
examples.en: The marriage was already a fact, so the parents had to agree.

meaning.en: To lay down one's life for one's country.
meaning.zh: 为国家献出生命。

examples.zh: 纪念碑上刻着为国捐躯的烈士的名字。
examples.en: The memorial bears the names of those who died for their country.

examples.zh: 他的祖父在战争中为国捐躯。
examples.en: His grandfather gave his life for his country in the war.

examples.zh: 我们不会忘记为国捐躯的英雄。
examples.en: We will never forget the heroes who made the ultimate sacrifice.

meaning.en: To have equal standing with someone.
meaning.zh: 比喻地位或权力平等。

examples.zh: 这家小公司现在已经能和巨头平起平坐了。
examples.en: This small firm can now deal with the giants on equal terms.

examples.zh: 在谈判桌上，双方平起平坐。
examples.en: At the negotiating table both sides are equals.

examples.zh: 他才工作一年，就想跟经理平起平坐？
examples.en: He's been here a year and thinks he's on a par with the manager?

meaning.en: Each has its own strengths.
meaning.zh: 各有各的长处、特色。

examples.zh: 这两位歌手各有千秋。
examples.en: Both singers have their own strengths.

examples.zh: 南北菜系各有千秋。
examples.en: Northern and southern cuisines each have their merits.

examples.zh: 参赛作品各有千秋，评委很难选择。
examples.en: The entries all had something special, so the judges struggled to choose.

meaning.en: So powerful one's shout could change the winds and clouds; mighty and influential.
meaning.zh: 一声呼喊就可以使风云变色，形容威力极大。

examples.zh: 他曾是商界叱咤风云的人物。
examples.en: He was once a towering figure in business.

examples.zh: 这位将军年轻时叱咤风云。
examples.en: In his youth the general was a force to be reckoned with.

examples.zh: 她在乐坛叱咤风云二十年。
examples.en: She dominated the music world for twenty years.

origin.source: 骆宾王《为徐敬业讨武曌檄》

story.en: Luo Binwang's call to arms against Empress Wu boasted that when their troops shouted, 'wind and clouds change colour' (叱咤则风云变色).
story.zh: 骆宾王《为徐敬业讨武曌檄》：“喑呜则山岳崩颓，叱咤则风云变色。”

meaning.en: Nobody knows what became of them in the end.
meaning.zh: 不知道结局或下落。

examples.zh: 那位画家晚年离家出走，不知所终。
examples.en: In old age the painter left home and was never heard of again.

examples.zh: 这批文物战后不知所终。
examples.en: What became of the relics after the war is unknown.

examples.zh: 当年的同学大多不知所终了。
examples.en: Most of my old classmates have long since vanished from my life.

meaning.en: To talk complete nonsense.
meaning.zh: 没有根据地瞎说。

examples.zh: 你别胡说八道，我根本没去过那儿。
examples.en: Don't talk rubbish — I've never been there.

examples.zh: 网上很多胡说八道的谣言。
examples.en: There's a lot of nonsense online.

examples.zh: 他喝多了就开始胡说八道。
examples.en: After a few drinks he starts talking nonsense.

meaning.en: To act completely unlike one's usual self.
meaning.zh: 完全改变了平时的态度或做法。

examples.zh: 平时话很多的他今天一反常态，一言不发。
examples.en: Usually chatty, he was uncharacteristically silent today.

examples.zh: 股市一反常态，连续上涨了十天。
examples.en: Bucking the trend, the market rose ten days in a row.

examples.zh: 她一反常态地早早起床做了早饭。
examples.en: Unusually for her, she got up early and made breakfast.

meaning.en: To pluck a feather from every passing goose: to take a cut of everything that passes through one's hands.
meaning.zh: 大雁飞过也要拔下几根毛，比喻爱占便宜，凡经手的事都要捞一把。

examples.zh: 这个官员雁过拔毛，每个项目都要拿回扣。
examples.en: The official took a cut of every project that crossed his desk.

examples.zh: 中间商雁过拔毛，农民挣不到钱。
examples.en: Middlemen skim off a share at every stage, leaving farmers with nothing.

examples.zh: 他那个人雁过拔毛，跟他合作要小心。
examples.en: He's grasping; be careful doing business with him.

meaning.en: With firm determination and no hesitation.
meaning.zh: 意志坚决，毫不犹豫。

examples.zh: 他毅然决然地辞去工作，回乡创业。
examples.en: He resolutely quit his job to start a business in his hometown.

examples.zh: 面对危险，她毅然决然地站了出来。
examples.en: Facing danger, she stepped forward without hesitation.

examples.zh: 他们毅然决然地踏上了征程。
examples.en: They set out on the journey with grim determination.

meaning.en: To step in on behalf of someone who is being treated unfairly.
meaning.zh: 见到不公平的事，挺身而出帮助受欺负的一方。

examples.zh: 他看见有人欺负小孩，就上前打抱不平。
examples.en: When he saw someone bullying a child, he stepped in.

examples.zh: 同事被冤枉，她第一个站出来打抱不平。
examples.en: When a colleague was wrongly blamed, she was the first to stand up for him.

examples.zh: 网友纷纷为这位外卖小哥打抱不平。
examples.en: Netizens rushed to defend the delivery rider.

usage.en: Predicate; often 为……打抱不平, 打个抱不平.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“为……打抱不平”，可拆开说“打个抱不平”。

meaning.en: To live out one's old age in comfort and good health.
meaning.zh: 保养身体，安享晚年。

equivalents: live out one's days in comfort

examples.zh: 退休后，他回老家颐养天年。
examples.en: After retiring he went back to his hometown to enjoy his twilight years.

examples.zh: 子女们都希望父母能颐养天年。
examples.en: The children all want their parents to live out their old age in comfort.

examples.zh: 这里环境优美，很适合老人颐养天年。
examples.en: The surroundings here are lovely, perfect for a peaceful retirement.

meaning.en: One's heart suddenly starts to race, from attraction or excitement.
meaning.zh: 形容心突然跳动起来，多指一见倾心或受到吸引。

examples.zh: 第一次见到她，他就怦然心动。
examples.en: The first time he saw her, his heart skipped a beat.

examples.zh: 这套房子的价格让人怦然心动。
examples.en: The price of the flat is very tempting.

examples.zh: 那是一种怦然心动的感觉。
examples.en: It was the feeling of falling for someone at first sight.

meaning.en: To summon wind and rain by magic; figuratively, to wield great power and influence.
meaning.zh: 原指神仙道士的法力，后比喻能支配自然或左右局势，也指进行煽动性活动。

examples.zh: 他在当地商界呼风唤雨。
examples.en: He calls the shots in local business circles.

examples.zh: 小说里的道士能呼风唤雨。
examples.en: The Taoist priest in the novel can summon wind and rain.

examples.zh: 昔日呼风唤雨的大亨如今破产了。
examples.en: The once all-powerful tycoon has gone bankrupt.
